title: Joint Quantization and Dynamic Partitioning for Context-Aware Edge Vision Transformers
abstract: arXiv:2611.14196v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Deploying vision transformer models across connected and automated vehicles (CAVs) requires joint management of computation and Vehicle-to-Vehicle (V2V) communication. Static split-inference methods use fixed partition points and cannot adapt to time-varying link bandwidth, processing load, and concurrent multi-stream traffic. This paper proposes an edge orchestration framework that jointly selects model partition points, per-layer quantization bitwidths, and execution placement across heterogeneous vehicular compute nodes. The joint partitioning and mixed-precision allocation problem is formulated as a Mixed-Integer Linear Program (MILP) that minimizes compute and communication energy subject to end-to-end latency and task-quality constraints. translated_title: 面向上下文感知边缘视觉Transformer的联合量化与动态分割
translated_abstract: 在网联自动驾驶车辆（CAVs）中部署视觉Transformer模型需要联合管理计算与车车（V2V）通信。静态分割推理方法使用固定的分割点，无法适应时变的链路带宽、处理负载以及并发的多流流量。本文提出了一种边缘编排框架，可在异构车辆计算节点上联合选择模型分割点、逐层量化位宽以及执行位置。该联合分割与混合精度分配问题被建模为混合整数线性规划（MILP），在端到端时延和任务质量约束下最小化计算与通信能耗。该框架在Jetson Orin Nano（8GB）、Jetson Orin NX（16GB）和Jetson AGX Orin（32GB）节点上，使用基于OPV2V驱动、K∈{2,4,6,8}的多流工作负载进行了评估。
tldr: 本文提出一种面向车联网边缘的编排框架，将模型分割点、逐层量化位宽与执行位置的联合选择建模为混合整数线性规划（MILP），在时延与任务质量约束下最小化计算和通信能耗，使视觉Transformer推理能够自适应时变的车车通信环境。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an edge orchestration framework that jointly selects model partition points, per-layer quantization bitwidths, and execution placement as a MILP, minimizing compute and communication energy under latency and task-quality constraints for adaptive vision transformer inference across heterogeneous vehicular compute nodes in CAVs.
